fact: HISP says it supported Togo's national health information systems directorate on a July 2026 field mission in the Savanes, Kara and Centrale regions to integrate the eRDQA app into the national DHIS2 platform, testing it in regional hospitals and health centres.

DHIS2 has been used by Togo's Ministry of Health since 2016 as the country's HMIS, its main data collection and aggregation tool and national repository for health data, owned and maintained by the ministry with HISP WCA support (DHIS2 profile, updated July 2026).
The profile says Togo also uses DHIS2 for infectious disease surveillance, alongside its HMIS role.

HISP WCA reports that the Ministry of Health is auditing and correcting data elements, indicators and metadata by programme in the DHIS2 of Togo's National Health Information System (SNIS), run by its DSNISI.
WAHO's workshop brings together Togo's national health information system managers, and the pilot aligns regional indicators with its national DHIS2 system.
